expected_rules_events: PRIOR_STATE: Control Magic (P0) enchanting Runeclaw Bear (owned P1, controlled P0)
CONCESSION/LOSS: P0 leaves the game (scripted loss)
LEAVE_CLEANUP: all objects owned by P0 leave with P0 (incl. Control Magic Aura)
CONTROL_REVERTS: Bear (owned P1) remains under P1 control (Aura gone)

NO_TRIGGER_CREATED (Bear never changes zones; Aura leaving with owner is not battlefield-to-graveyard for any witness)
